frames.name: formal-passage-268
frames.observed:
Welcome to the Haba History Museum.
 Your admission ticket includes access to our permanent collection and today's guided tour at 230.
 The special photography exhibition on the upper floor requires a separate ticket which is available at the information desk.
 Audio guides can be borrowed free of charge by leaving a photo ID with the attendant.
 Please return the guide before collecting your ID.
 Large bugs must be stored in the lockers near the entrance.
 The museum closes at 6 and the last admission to the photography exhibition is at 5.
